mod_desc_fabric_api: Core hook and API library, essential for most Fabric mods.
mod_desc_sodium: Revolutionary rendering engine for Fabric. Maximum FPS and smoothness.
mod_desc_iris: Modern, fast shader loader for Fabric, compatible with OptiFine shaderpacks.
mod_desc_lithium: General-purpose optimization mod for physics, mob AI, and world generation.
mod_desc_modmenu: Adds a mod list screen and config menu directly to the main menu.
mod_desc_indium: Fabric Rendering API implementation for Sodium, needed by mods with custom 3D blocks.
mod_desc_trinkets: Custom accessory slot system for rings, belts, and amulets on Fabric.
mod_desc_embeddium: Fast and stable official Sodium port for Forge and NeoForge. Maximum FPS.
mod_desc_oculus: Iris Shaders port for Forge and NeoForge. Modern shader support without OptiFine.
mod_desc_create: Kinetic contraptions, gears, windmills, trains, and factory automation.
mod_desc_ironchests: Expandable storage chests made of copper, iron, gold, diamond, crystal, and obsidian.
mod_desc_sophisticatedbackpacks: Upgradable backpacks with auto-sorting, magnet, auto-smelting, and back-wear support.
mod_desc_biomesoplenty: Over 50 beautiful new biomes in the Overworld, Nether, and End with unique flora.
mod_desc_alexsmobs: Over 85 unique creatures and animals with custom abilities, animations, and drops.
mod_desc_curios: Flexible equipment and accessory slot system for rings, capes, and magical baubles.
mod_desc_mekanism: High-tech machinery: 5x ore processing, nuclear fusion, jetpacks, and digital miners.
mod_desc_botania: Natural tech and magic mod centered around mystical flowers, mana, and ancient relics.
mod_desc_twilightforest: Legendary twilight realm featuring dungeons, labyrinthine castles, unique bosses, and loot.
mod_desc_jei: View all crafting recipes, smelting recipes, and item uses directly inside inventory.
mod_desc_appleskin: Displays food saturation and estimated health restoration directly on the HUD.
mod_desc_journeymap: Real-time world map featuring waypoints, cave mapping, mob radar, and web browser view.
mod_desc_xaeros_minimap: Smooth, lightweight minimap with waypoints, death markers, and custom HUD layouts.
mod_desc_waystones: Teleportation waystone monoliths to travel between bases and dimensions using scrolls.
mod_desc_mousetweaks: Smooth mouse-wheel dragging, fast stacking, and item sorting inside inventories.
mod_desc_clumps: Clumps scattered experience orbs together into single orbs to prevent FPS lag.
mod_desc_farmersdelight: Cozy culinary and farming overhaul: cooking pots, skillets, knives, and rich recipes.
mod_desc_jade: Informative tooltip HUD displayed when hovering over any block or entity.
mod_desc_controlling: Search and filter keybinds, highlighting free and conflicting controls in settings.
ely_login_invalid: Invalid login or password on Ely.by
